newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian all-share index at another all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian all-share index at another all-time high.

text.p: The Egyptian all-share index closed at a record high on Monday, up 5.34 points at 427.77 from 422.43 at the close on Sunday, the Capital Market Authority said.
The all-share index had last closed at a record high on Thursday, when it hit 423.09 points. That was the 22nd record close in as many trading days.
The all-share index has now risen 44 percent this year.
